iOS · Wisconsin Creative · Notifications Slice 3b

Notification Settings Shortcuts

People now reach notification settings from where they think of them: the inbox, the app's page in iOS Settings, and shared /settings/notifications links.

Side by side

Same hosted-view test, stub inbox, forced refresh failure, xxxLarge text, iPhone 18 Pro Max. Before is clean HEAD; after adds this work only.

Inbox toolbar

What changed, and why

A link from iOS Settings

Was

The app's page in iOS Settings only offered system alert styles.

Now

It also shows 'Notification Settings', which opens our own preferences. Existing users get the link at next launch, with no new prompt.

Links open the native screen

Was

A /settings/notifications link fell back to the inbox.

Now

Universal links, wisconsin:// links, and notification hrefs all open Profile → Notifications. Other /settings pages still open nothing natively.

Inbox dates match the web

Was

Rows grouped by when they were created.

Now

Rows group and label by when they were sent, falling back to created, like the web inbox.

Removed an action iOS never registered

Was

A GT_VIEW action identifier existed with no category using it.

Now

Gone; a plain tap already opens the destination.

Verification

  • npm run ios:xcode:verify on the iPhone 18 Pro Max (isolated worktree of HEAD plus this work): drift, simulator build, full XCTest suite including new route tests, generic device build — passed
  • NotificationInboxTests.testInboxRecoveryCapture — passed on both before and after trees
  • iOS notification, deep-link, long-press, and settings source contracts — 58 passed
  • npm run verify:docs — current

Things to know

  • The iOS Settings link and openSettingsFor callback can only be exercised on a device or simulator with notifications allowed; this simulator's install has not granted permission, so that path is source- and build-verified only.
  • Built in an isolated worktree because a concurrent Schedule refactor in the main checkout still does not compile.
  • 'in 0s' on both sides is the stub rows being dated at render time, not a change.
